title: Permission-set grid: Bulk column cut at 1440 with no cue, Object column not sticky on phones, two "Owner" labels (#27521 row 17)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY2n1JmZZKrHgtp9jC

Filing gate: ② a wrong or confusing state shown to the user. Split from #27521 row 17 by the seat; the parent's acceptance says each row is taken as its own card or answered.

## Business reason

Who: every administrator editing a permission set. What happens: at 1440 px the grid scrolls sideways with the Bulk column cut and no cue that more columns exist; on a phone the Object column scrolls away so a row's checkboxes lose their object; two fields are both labelled "Owner"; with field rows expanded the header labels drift from their columns. Reach: every administrator editing a set.

## Mechanism

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`.

Read in the 18.3.0 RC browser walkthrough at `c4c515ad`; the path is confirmed on `main` (not re-driven).

## Wanted

A sticky first (Object) column, an overflow cue when columns are cut, disambiguated labels for the two "Owner" fields, and headers that stay aligned with field rows expanded.

## Acceptance

- [ ] At 1440 px the cut columns are signalled (edge fade or cue), and on a phone the Object column stays visible while scrolling.
- [ ] No two columns or fields carry the same label.
- [ ] With field rows expanded, each header sits over its column.

Refs #27521
